claimsToVerify.phrase: Privacy-first traffic, top pages, and store revenue for every site — no extra scripts.
claimsToVerify.concern: ‘for every site’ reads as a cross-site analytics rollup, which is on the do-not-claim list. The sibling Explore card drops the phrase and says only ‘Privacy-first traffic, top pages, and store revenue.’ Confirm whether analytics is per-site only before shipping this wording.

claimsToVerify.phrase: sites, commerce, forms, media, workflows, and analytics across every host
claimsToVerify.concern: Same cross-site analytics rollup concern — ‘analytics across every host’ implies an aggregated view. Verify or reword to per-host.

claimsToVerify.phrase: Search sites, orders, contacts… / Recent activity: ‘New contact added’
claimsToVerify.concern: The console dashboard mockup shows a Contacts entity in both the global search placeholder and the activity feed. A Contacts CRM is on the do-not-claim list. Either the mockup needs those strings changed before it is rebuilt, or the CRM must be confirmed to exist.
